title: US futures sharply higher after Democratic route in midterm elections
description: U.S. stock futures are sharply higher after the U.S. midterm election yielded majorities for the Democrats in both houses of Congress. Investors parsed the potential impact on artificial intelligence, the defense and wind energy sectors, as well as Big Oil. The results bring a new era of congressional resistance to the agenda pursued aggressively by U.S. President Donald Trump. One overarching theme was that divided government might not be such a bad thing. Markets generally prefer that control of Washington be split between the Republicans and the Democrats. That is seen as offering less risk of sweeping policy changes that could upend the economy.
